separate_allocation_calls.measure: Python tracemalloc complete call; not RSS; serialization and replay are outside tracing

acceptance.raw_conditional_probability_diagnostics: maximum, nonzero count, and at most ten largest full-row/action examples; complete payloads retain every probability

method: Authenticate the immutable measured CFR+ publication before measuring. Rank-free preflight charges all requested 140-sweep jobs at three passes regardless of averaging delay. Retain 18 paired complete calls, two separate delay-one allocation calls, canonical serialization/hash inside timed calls, two independent physical-world records, strict independent policy replay, every scalar cross-backend gap, all-row action realization comparison, and bounded examples plus maximum/count for raw conditional-probability differences. Preserve the original zero-delay 0.005-chip quality miss; no convergence improvement or speed claim is assumed.
scope: One weighted 5,940-world full-future fixed-flop heads-up game with configured betting decisions on flop, turn and river. CFR+ averaging delay is opt-in and limited to recursive/public-batched flop starts. No unrestricted NLHE, multiway, full-deck preflop, universal delay benefit, equal-work cross-model or RSS claim.
candidate_source_identity: A clean Git revision and complete source-hash snapshot are captured before and after measurement; baseline source is separate.
